build_speech_to_speech_task: build a SpeechToSpeechTask to configure and run speech-to-speech translation with discrete unit or spectrogram targets
generate_stack_unit_sequence: generate stacked unit sequences using StackUnitSequenceGenerator with viterbi search for multi-frame prediction
build_generator_for_s2s: build a sequence generator for speech-to-speech models supporting vocoder-based or discrete code output
run_valid_step_with_inference: run validation with inference to compute mel cepstral distortion loss between target and predicted waveforms
pack_units_for_stacked_frames: pack multiple discrete unit frames into a single reduced vocabulary token using StackUnitSequenceGenerator.pack_units
